race.description: Kirk's Bridge Farm Country Boosted Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: SHOWTIME MAGGIE (9) brings two solid thirds, with the latest at Sapphire Coast carrying extra merit after she was steadied and had difficulty obtaining clear running. Can be a frustrating watch for punters, but if she puts it all together she's good enough to win a race like this. VEREEVA (10) also comes out of BM66 grade and her Nowra fourth was better than the market expected, especially after another slow getaway before she charged home. MARINE GIRL (5) has been racing in BM66 company and was close two back at Bathurst. That effort suggests she's right in this despite the wide alley. WITCH OF NOVEMBER (12) won't be far away on the back of a sharp last start win.
